description: Source code for a ValidationService class that handles validation runs, report generation, and retrieval within a data validation system. Includes methods for executing validations, checking schema conformance, and managing validation reports.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service for validation run execution and report generation.

methods.name: run_validation
methods.description: Executes a validation run, generates a report, stores artifacts, updates submission state, and records an audit event.

methods.name: _check_schema_conformance
methods.description: Checks if the dataset hash is a placeholder; fails if so, otherwise passes.

methods.name: _check_freshness
methods.description: Performs a freshness check on the dataset.

methods.name: _check_completeness
methods.description: Performs a completeness check on the package.

methods.name: get_validation_report
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report by validation run ID, loading from storage if available.

methods.name: list_validation_runs
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a submission.
